At PetZone Mahalaxmi Veterinary Clinic, we are dedicated to the health and well-being of your beloved pets. Knowing when to seek immediate veterinary attention can make all the difference in emergency situations. Here are some critical warning signs that indicate your pet may require urgent care:

1. **Difficulty Breathing**: Labored breathing is a significant red flag. It may indicate respiratory distress and needs immediate medical evaluation.

2. **Sudden Lethargy**: If your pet suddenly becomes unusually tired or inactive, it could be a sign of a serious underlying condition.

3. **Refusal to Eat for More Than 24 Hours**: A sudden loss of appetite, especially when prolonged, can indicate different health threats.

4. **Seizures**: Whether single or multiple, seizures are a medical emergency requiring prompt attention.

featured_reviews.review_text:

I’ve had relentlessly bad and suspicious experiences at big pet hospitals, clinics etc- who only focus on charging more than its worth, don’t really care about prompt diagnosis or correct advice, it’s all commercialisation. My gut couldn’t trust any one in past 2 years.

With God’s grace, I somehow came across Dr. Nitin’s Myraplus clinic recently and after reading the reviews, I couldn’t wait to meet him for Cece. She is currently going through some health related issues, and i’ve never been put at ease before like how Dr. Nitin has put me at ease. He is kind, calm, carefully and accurately explains everything which always puts me at ease. I tend to get extremely paranoid even when there’s slightest inconvenience to Cece, I cry until there’s no end;  but Dr. Nitin’s helpful vibe, confidence, behaviour, knowledge and genuineness gives me much relief - knowing that he is giving correct treatment to my baby Cece. He actually also focuses on administering minimal load of antibiotics which is great in a long run.

He is not money minded unlike other vets (which always made me worry about my baby’s health) ; rather he genuinely cares for and wants to help all kinds of animals (which are our lifelines)!

No unnecessary stress of consistent blood works for no reason, Myraplus has quite reasonable with their test prices too yet, on a side note. My baby Cece is currently been treated under Dr.Nitin’s care and till now I trust him a 100% with my gut for my baby :)
I believe y’ll should hit him up whenever in need :)

featured_reviews.name: Vishva Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
We trusted this clinic with our 2-year-old cat during the most critical time of his life, and today we are left with heartbreak, trauma, and serious doubts about the care he received.

Our cat was already battling pleural effusion/FIP-related illness, but after the second drainage procedure done at this clinic, his condition worsened dramatically. Unlike the first drainage done elsewhere after which he breathed better and stabilized this time he developed pneumothorax and his breathing never improved afterward.

We were never properly prepared for how unstable his condition had become post-procedure. We also specifically informed the staff that our cat became extremely frightened and aggressive when touched without us present, and requested that he not be unnecessarily handled while we briefly stepped out. Despite that, he was taken out and handled. When we returned, we were met with his lifeless body.

Maybe no one can say with certainty what would have changed the outcome. But as pet parents who watched the drastic difference between the first and second procedures, we cannot ignore the feeling that mistakes, inadequate handling, or complications during treatment may have contributed to his final deterioration.

Losing a pet is devastating enough. Being left with unanswered questions and guilt afterward makes it even harder.

I hope this clinic learns to communicate more transparently, handle critical patients more carefully, and show greater sensitivity toward animals who are already terrified and struggling to survive.

featured_reviews.name: sms sweta
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a pet parent, I’m sure many of you will understand the kind of fear and helplessness we feel when something isn’t right with our baby. I went through exactly that when my 14-year-old feline, Goldie, was diagnosed with a serious tumour on her left paw. Those days were filled with worry, questions, and uncertainty.

All we knew was that we needed the right oncologist — someone we could trust completely. That’s when we found the incredible team at Superpets, and from that very first visit, everything began to feel a little lighter.

From explaining the diagnosis and possible causes, to guiding us through every test, every step was handled with so much patience, clarity, and compassion. What truly stood out was how reassuring the entire team was — always available to answer questions, clear doubts, and take that extra effort to make both us and Goldie feel comfortable.

The journey — from diagnosis, to surgery, to post-operative care and stitch removal — was smoother than we could have ever hoped for. Every decision they made felt right, thoughtful, and in Goldie’s best interest.

A special note of gratitude to Dr. Pratyush, Dr. Vasudha, and Dr. Gauri — you are truly angels in disguise. The care, dedication, and gentleness with which you handled Goldie means the world to us. It’s not just medical expertise, but your genuine love for animals that makes all the difference.

I must admit, I was initially skeptical about traveling all the way from the suburbs to Bandra for treatment — but today, I can say with complete conviction that every visit, every effort, was absolutely worth it.

What touched me deeply was that even after a month, Dr. Pratyush personally followed up to check on Goldie’s health. That level of care is rare and speaks volumes about the kind of people they are — not just doctors, but true lifesavers.

This entire experience has been a journey of gratitude. People like them are not just treating animals — they are healing families.

Thank you, Superpets team, from the bottom of my heart, for taking such beautiful care of our baby.

Forever grateful. 🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Yash Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank Superpets enough for the incredible care they’ve provided to my two cats.

Dr. Yash is a highly skilled veterinarian and has build this amazing facility where pets receive world-class care. Everybody in the team from the doctors to the reception staff have genuine compassion towards animals.

I am deeply grateful to Dr. Ashok and Dr. Vasudha for their constant guidance for both my cats over time. On more than one occasion, they literally saved the life of one of my cats who was critically sick. Thanks to them, my cat got a second chance to life.

I highly recommend Superpets!! My cats are healthy and happy today because of this amazing team. Thank you for everything you do❤️

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Chhangani
featured_reviews.review_text: A very professional and qualified set of Doctors who streamline diagnosis and start the correct treatment extremely fast without wasting any time. Thankful to Dr. Omkar for his professionalism and patience with all my questions. He started the diagnosis & treatment for my 48 day old Lab puppy when we rushed him in at 12am. Follow-ups were extremely smooth thanks to Dr. Shefali as she was extremely kind and generous with my pet. She knew exactly what needed to be done and the internal communication between the doctors are spot on and on the same page. I really loved the fact that each doctor is on the same page even the one who is not treating my puppy, Dr. Nishant. The set of Doctors help and consult each other well to discuss exactly which treatment will be right for the pet. I used to believe SuperPets is an expensive clinic which will keep doing tests to increase bill but when I visited the clinic I realised, I was so wrong. Everything right from follow-ups, to chat support, to the doctors actually calling/messaging you to check how your pet is doing post the treatment are all just professional and seamless. I would recommend SuperPets 10/10 after my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mira Saraf
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been taking my dogs, Angel and Cookie, as well as our new kitten Oreo to Dr. Gauri and Dr. Pratyush (and more recently Dr. Nikhil) at Superpets for the last several years, and they've all been really well-looked after. They never push me towards any unnecessary treatments, but when there is an issue, they handle it quickly and effectively, explaining all the options. They give me peace of mind, and I appreciate the care they've taken with my animals. They're very good and very professional. I would definitely recommend them!

featured_reviews.name: Darshana M
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the best vet experience I've had till now. All the staff, including the service staff are very courteous, kind and helpful. All the vets are patient and explain the issues. Thank you to Drs Nikhil, Nishant and Yash. The only problem is that they don't believe in a vegan diet and wanted me to give animal products to my dog, which is against my ethics. The billing needs to be streamlined as I had to wait after the treatment was done for the first few days and follow up with the staff for NEFT payments. All in all, we need such well equipped and round the clock hospitals with such attentive staff iin each and every city, town and village.

featured_reviews.name: Megan DSa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ive always had good experience with hospital. The staff is extremely caring, patient, and clearly passionate about animals. The vets take the time to explain everything in detail and make sure you’re comfortable with the treatment plan. What stood out the most was how gently and attentively they handled my pet which instantly put me at ease.

The clinic is clean, well-maintained, and organized, which adds to the overall sense of trust.  I truly appreciate the level of professionalism and compassion shown here. Highly recommend this place to any pet parent looking for reliable and quality care.

featured_reviews.name: Smitaa Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a blessing. My German shepherd champ was taken to super pets in an emergency situation. He had developed something called GDV. I was unaware if this situation being a pet parent since more than 17 years now (I have had pets since several years) After taking him to vetic hospital for emergency (which was extremely careless and didn’t even treat it like emergency) post his X-ray on recommendation from some friends I rushed him to super pets. They immediately took charge of the situation. He underwent operation and was discharged in 5 days. We had to take him for regular follow ups and on a follow up in a weeks time, doctors suspected something wrong and again on further tests discovered that his spleen had got affected and damaged along with few further conditions that had developed. He underwent second surgery. He battled for his life for a month in this hospital. He was hospitalised. The care, affection and love he recieved along with the proper medical care is nothing less than a gift for parents seeing their child fight for life and death each day. Inspite of he being aggressive he was pampered and taken care of as if he belongs to them. His entire body had collapsed and post 1 month he finally got discharged. He had lost his ability to walk post all this condition as his hip and spine had got affected. We continued Physio with them. It’s October today. My boy got discharged in June and we are in our way for our regular Physio all hail and hearty, not just walking but running and bullying my other 2 dogs :) No words can thank them enough. His recovery is nothing less than a miracle only because of timely care and attention given to him by the super vets at super pets.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Phatak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to appreciate the superpets veterinary clinic for the professionalism and high standards of hygiene maintained during my cat’s surgery. The doctors and staff were extremely professional, attentive, and helpful.
The clinic was clean, which was my main concern and well-maintained, which gave me confidence that my pet was in safe hands. The team ensured to provide clear guidance throughout.
Overall, I am grateful for the dedicated care and professional and caring approach shown by the clinic while treating my cat. Highly appreciated.
